report.summary: The pod exists and is running: api-gateway-585c5579f6-9zd5g in namespace app-102a, phase Running, container nginx ready with 0 restarts, image nginx:latest, started 2026-11-22T09:54:10Z, owned by ReplicaSet api-gateway-585c5579f6 (owner Deployment api-gateway). Container stdout logs are only a clean nginx 1.31.9 startup (23 lines, no error text). Application request logs in Loki for the selector {namespace="app-102a", pod=~"api-gateway.*"} returned 97 lines between 2026-11-22T07:14:10Z and 2026-11-22T09:54:10Z, all of them HTTP 2xx (200/201/204) responses with response_time_ms between 51 and 199; an error-filtered Loki query returned no lines, which is a no_data result and not proof of absence. Resource recommendations can only be configuration-based: the container declares no resources at all (resources: {} in both the pod and the Deployment template), no liveness/readiness/startup probes, and uses imagePullPolicy Always with the mutable tag nginx:latest. Live CPU/memory usage could not be measured because Prometheus returned SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE on every attempt (get_metric_names and execute_prometheus_instant_query), so no usage-based sizing numbers can be given — only starting-point recommendations to be validated against measured usage. No fault, crash, eviction or OOM was observed for this pod; the 09:54Z events are a Deployment scale-up from 0 to 1 replica with a fresh pod (SuccessfulCreate, Scheduled, Created, Started), i.e. a rollout, not damage. The only Warning events in the window are FailedToCreateEndpoint events for services in namespaces app-95 and app-162, which are unrelated to api-gateway. Conclusion is partial: logs were obtained, but the utilization data needed for quantitative recommendations is missing.

claims.text: Pod api-gateway-585c5579f6-9zd5g in namespace app-102a is Running with one container named nginx (image nginx:latest), ready=true, restartCount=0, lastState empty, running since 2026-11-22T09:54:10Z; its owner reference is ReplicaSet api-gateway-585c5579f6.

The Deployment api-gateway (namespace app-102a, 1 replica, labels app=nginx, owner of ReplicaSet api-gateway-585c5579f6) declares container nginx with resources: {} — no CPU or memory requests or limits — and no livenessProbe, readinessProbe or startupProbe; imagePullPolicy is Always with the mutable tag nginx:latest. The pod spec shows the same empty resources.

The current container's stdout for pod api-gateway-585c5579f6-9zd5g contains 23 lines from 2026-11-22T09:54:10.588Z to 09:54:10.662Z: docker-entrypoint configuration messages and nginx/1.31.9 notices (epoll event method, 8 worker processes started), with no error, warning or exit message; the tool reported no previous container instance for this pod.

Loki query {namespace="app-102a", pod=~"api-gateway.*"} over 2026-11-21T09:54:18Z–2026-11-22T09:54:18Z returned 97 lines (below the 200 limit, nothing omitted) from a single stream (labels app=nginx, job=nginx, service_name=nginx, pod=api-gateway-585c5579f6-9zd5g), timestamped 2026-11-22T07:14:10Z to 09:54:10Z, each an "HTTP request completed" record with status 200, 201 or 204 on paths /health, /api/v1/users, /api/v1/orders, /api/v1/products and /api/v1/inventory, with response_time_ms values between 51 and 199.

The pod's creation at 09:54:09–09:54:10Z was a controller-driven scale-up: Deployment api-gateway event ScalingReplicaSet "Scaled up replica set api-gateway-585c5579f6 from 0 to 1", ReplicaSet api-gateway-585c5579f6 event SuccessfulCreate "Created pod: api-gateway-585c5579f6-9zd5g", and Pod events Scheduled (assigned to opspilot-m1-control-plane), Pulled (nginx:latest, 63934605 bytes), Created and Started. No Evicted, OOMKilled, BackOff, Failed or Unhealthy event for this pod appears in the window.

The only Warning events in the authorized window are FailedToCreateEndpoint on Endpoints objects "orca" (service app-95/orca, 2026-11-22T09:21:00Z) and "signup-service" (service app-162/signup-service, 2026-11-22T09:32:52Z); neither involves namespace app-102a or the api-gateway workload.
The single node opspilot-m1-control-plane reports allocatable cpu=8, memory=32859944Ki and pods=110, which is the capacity context for any request/limit values proposed for this 1-replica workload.

Because container nginx declares no requests and no limits, the pod would be in the BestEffort QoS class, making it first in line to be evicted under node memory pressure and giving it no guaranteed CPU share; this is inferred from the empty resources field, not from an observed eviction or throttling event.

Add explicit resources to container nginx in Deployment api-gateway as a starting point: requests cpu 100m / memory 64Mi and limits cpu 500m / memory 128Mi, then adjust from measured usage. This is advice only — live CPU and memory series were unavailable, so these numbers are not derived from observed utilization.

Add a readinessProbe and livenessProbe on the already declared containerPort 80 (for example HTTP GET /health), since the Deployment defines none while the application logs show /health served with 2xx responses; also pin the image to an immutable tag or digest instead of nginx:latest with imagePullPolicy Always so rollouts are reproducible.

The query for horizontalpodautoscalers in app-102a returned status=no_data (evidence d380959d-dd47-42f6-aec8-df2892641a95-t1:852a7ef0-fd0c-4272-bcb2-cea90cefce42) and the query for resourcequotas in app-102a returned status=no_data (evidence b2ee7e15-3985-407a-b5f9-4b66a6ffd882-t1:55d423bb-fddd-45b8-8e33-c6296864f28d); absence of autoscaling and quota settings is unconfirmed rather than observed.

Loki lines carry labels pod=api-gateway-585c5579f6-9zd5g with timestamps from 2026-11-22T07:14:10Z onward, earlier than the pod's recorded startedAt of 2026-11-22T09:54:10Z; whether these came from an earlier instance with the same pod name or from ingest/parse timestamps (the tool states the timestamp is ingest/parse time, not event time) could not be determined.
No previous container instance exists for pod api-gateway-585c5579f6-9zd5g, so logs from before the 09:54:10Z start of the current container could not be read from the pod.
The change_history integration is not available in this Run, so no record of who changed the Deployment (for example removing resources and probes) or when could be checked.
next_steps: Restore the Prometheus scrape/query path so container_cpu_usage_seconds_total, container_memory_working_set_bytes and kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total can be queried for namespace app-102a, then right-size requests and limits from measured p95 usage.
Confirm separately whether a Service in app-102a should select this workload, since the services query in that namespace returned no objects.
Review Deployment api-gateway in version control or change history to find when resources and probes were omitted and when the nginx:latest tag was introduced.
